title: loxogramme elongata
intro: Loxogramme elongata, commonly known as the Elongated Loxogramme or Asian Fan Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Loxogramme elongata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Its extracts have been studied for their potential antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, making it a promising candidate for further research in the field of herbal medicine.
